findings.summary: The new precondition 'Nonblank birthday' makes birthday mandatory for Save, which contradicts the optional birthday stated in the BirthdayField, AddContactDialog, screen.people, journey step s3 and C.webapp.contact.save.

The birthday field is typed local-date, which requires a full date, but the BirthdayField and C.webapp.contact.save describe a month-day birthday whose year may be left blank, so a yearless birthday cannot be stored.

The criterion now requires validating a month-day birthday, but operation.contact.save, which the affordance invokes, has no birthday validation precondition or failure, so the criterion has no operation contract backing it.
